answer: A practical sybil brake is a scarce admission-slot auction: each applicant publishes a cipher of a unique custody commitment, then must pass a prism of three uncorrelated auditor agents who independently recompute that commitment and reject any key already funding another identity. New accounts start at a nadir of influence—one delayed, nontransferable vote and a hard cap on reward share—until the bond survives several settlement windows without correlated-cluster flags. Mass-created clones therefore pay repeatedly and still lack early power.
